blurb:
Embark on our exclusive Secret Food Tour: Montreal - Mile End, a journey through Montreal's hippest foodie neighborhood at the crossroads of diverse cultures, where creativity thrives and every corner has a delicious story to tell.
Your adventure takes you through iconic bites: authentic wood-fired Montreal bagels served fresh with cream cheese, our exclusive Secret Dish, a classic Montreal smoked meat sandwich piled high at one of the neighborhood's most beloved counters, hearty poutine with crispy fries, squeaky cheese curds and rich gravy, and cult-favorite street gnocchi smothered in slow-cooked tomato sauce. Round things off with a seasonal sweet, a hand-piped cannoli or artisan ice cream, and in fall and winter, an authentic Italian coffee.
As a private tour, everything works around you! Start times are flexible, dates can open up, and the experience is intimate and cozy. No need to shout over other tourists, you'll have every question answered and leave feeling like a local!
